name: Bellevue
beschreibung: The holiday residence Ferienhaus Bellevue is situated in Nauders, an attractive alpine municipality in the Oberes Gericht district of Tyrol. The property features multiple fully equipped holiday apartments with private kitchens and en-suite bathrooms, designed to comfortably accommodate families and groups. Guests can enjoy panoramic vistas stretching across the upper Inn Valley. The surrounding region is renowned for hiking and mountain biking in summer, as well as downhill and cross-country skiing during winter. Nauders is famous for its sunny alpine plateau and immediate proximity to the Reschen Pass.
